summary: Iteration 6: tested all P1+P2 features. 121/121 backend tests pass (98 regression + 23 new). Frontend critical flows verified: streaming chat, search, Big Five, mood chart, personality chooser, audit log, sync. Found and fixed 1 backend bug in /api/sync/import (Mongo path conflict on created_at). One minor frontend issue: 'Download my cloud data' button not detected on /privacy though user is in cloud mode (label may differ). Search empty-state lacks search-results testid (renders 'Nothing here for X' instead).

minor.issue: FIXED: $set + $setOnInsert both contained created_at causing Mongo WriteError 40 (path conflict). Moved created_at exclusively to $setOnInsert.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Download my cloud data' button text not found on /privacy with mode=cloud. Either button is not rendering or copy differs from spec.
Empty-state ('Nothing here for X') is rendered without data-testid=search-results wrapper, so empty searches can't be asserted via that testid.

action_items: Verify /privacy renders 'Download my cloud data' button when storage mode=cloud (or update spec text).
Optional: wrap Search empty-state inside data-testid=search-results so 0-result state is testable.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2234 lines — should be split into modules (auth, journal, ai, personality, missions, admin, sync) for maintainability.
_bulk in sync_import previously had Mongo path conflict — defensive coding needed when mixing $set and $setOnInsert (now fixed).
FastAPI on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated; migrate to lifespan handlers.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (5/6 flows verified; privacy download button missing)

seed_data_creation: Tests create transient TEST_-prefixed journal items + delete them; created 1 Big Five assessment for user_id=test-user-pericl-1777377818066 (id pa_*).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_pericl_p1_p2_features.py for the new feature regression. SSE streaming works on both /api/ai/chat/stream (cloud, persists, sends meta frame) and /api/ai/chat-stateless/stream (no persist). User test_sess_1777379746360 currently in cloud mode.
rca of the issue: sync/import 500: _bulk passed allow_keys list including 'created_at' so the field landed in $set, while $setOnInsert also tried to set created_at — Mongo rejects this with 'Updating the path created_at would create a conflict at created_at' (code 40). Fix: pop created_at from $set and use only in $setOnInsert.
